title: HES1 contributes to high salt stress response as an enhancer of NFAT5-DNA binding
authors: Hiroki Ryuno; Yusuke Hanafusa; Isao Naguro; Hidenori Ichijo
one_liner_zh: 该文通过siRNA筛选发现HES1增强NFAT5与靶启动子DNA结合以响应高盐应激，涉及TF-DNA结合调控但无AI或物理模拟方法，属实验生物学研究，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: High salt conditions and subsequent hyperosmolarity are injurious cellular stresses but can activate immune signaling. Nuclear factor of activated T-cells 5 (NFAT5) is an essential transcription factor that induces osmoprotective genes such as aldose reductase (AR) and betaine-GABA transporter 1 (BGT1). High salt stress-mediated NFAT5 activation is also reported to accelerate the inflammatory response and autoimmune diseases. However, the systemic regulation of NFAT5 remains unclear. Here, we performed a genome-wide siRNA screen to comprehensively identify the upstream factors of NFAT5. We monitored NFAT5 nuclear translocation and identified one of the Notch signaling effectors, Hairy and enhancer of split-1 (HES1), as a novel positive regulator of NFAT5. HES1 was induced by high salinity via ERK signaling and facilitated NFAT5 recruitment to its target promoter region, resulting in the proper induction of osmoprotective genes and cytoprotection under high salt stress. These findings suggest that although HES1 is well known as a transcriptional repressor, it positively regulates NFAT5-dependent transcription in the context of a high salinity/hyperosmotic response. One Sentence Summary HES1 contributes to high salinity/hyperosmotic response through positive regulation of NFAT5-dependent transcription.
abstract_zh: 高盐条件及随之而来的高渗状态是对细胞的有害应激，但也能激活免疫信号。活化T细胞核因子5（NFAT5）是一种关键转录因子，可诱导渗透保护基因，如醛糖还原酶（AR）和甜菜碱-GABA转运蛋白1（BGT1）。据报道，高盐应激介导的NFAT5激活还会加速炎症反应和自身免疫疾病。然而，NFAT5的系统性调控机制仍不清楚。在此，我们进行了全基因组siRNA筛选，以全面鉴定NFAT5的上游因子。我们监测了NFAT5的核转位，并鉴定出Notch信号效应因子之一——发状分裂增强子-1（HES1）——作为NFAT5的新型正调控因子。HES1通过ERK信号在高盐条件下被诱导，并促进NFAT5向其靶启动子区域募集，从而在高盐应激下正确诱导渗透保护基因并实现细胞保护。这些发现表明，尽管HES1众所周知是转录抑制因子，但在高盐/高渗反应背景下，它正向调控NFAT5依赖性转录。一句话摘要：HES1通过正向调控NFAT5依赖性转录，参与高盐/高渗反应。
